1.consolidated_definition: antic. Cierto baile popular. “Otros bailes cultos y modernos, bien seis, gato y ratón, zapateaos y el borococo, bailes rústicos del país.” Tapia, Mis memorias, 1826-1882; 1927, p. 122.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Antic. A certain popular dance. "Other cultivated and modern dances, such as seis, gato and ratón, zapateaos and the borococo, rustic country dances." Tapia, Mis memorias, 1826-1882; 1927, p. 122.
